title: I mustn’t forget
html_source: Once the reader has established the external and internal narrative in the previous paragraph, the implication is that a chill breeze took his mind off the challenging thought strands and returned him to the social world – his two errands. Joyce still does not tag any intention of Stephen’s onto these errands. We learn nothing of Stephen’s motivations and conflicts by these tasks.

 Airs romped round him, nipping and eager airs. They are coming, waves. The whitemaned seahorses, champing, brightwindbridled, the steeds of Mananaan.
